messages:
Lenora (Design): quick QA pass on the vectors/batch export modal and the preview table. uploaded a revised Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123
Amit (Frontend): saw the figma — can you call out the must-fix items only?
Lenora (Design): must-fix: 1) selection state is not preserved when paginating (users assume multi-page selection). 2) export modal focus return lands on an offscreen element after close. 3) tiny contrast issue on relevance-score pill at 12px.
Jasper (A11y): for (1) we should implement an aria-live counter announcing total selected ("5 rows selected"). also we must persist selection server-side or in localStorage so screen reader users retain context across pages.
Priya (PM): product take: default export format should be JSONL with an explicit label. CSV export should require a column-mapping step in the modal. we need the flow to make mapping obvious — not hidden under advanced options.
Marta (Engineering): backend already accepts a payload with explicit vector_ids, so persistence is doable. current UI kept selection in-memory which drops on refresh. plan: keep a persistent selection layer and reconcile on load.
Amit (Frontend): I'll add a selection store and aria-live region. one implementation snippet for export body:
```
format=jsonl
fields=vector_id,embedding,metadata.source
ids=["v123","v456"]
```
Lenora (Design): CTA copy: instead of generic "Export selected" use "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" and provide a clear secondary action: "Export CSV — map columns".
Ken (Product): +1, and add a microcopy helper under the CSV option: "Map metadata fields to CSV columns; preview shown below." Keep it short.
Amit (Frontend): tooltip/accessibility note: long metadata cells are truncated with ellipses but not keyboard-accessible. we should show a focusable tooltip (title attr doesn't meet keyboard needs) and a small copy icon to copy the full value (aria-label="Copy full value").
Jasper (A11y): also ensure dialog uses role="dialog" and aria-modal="true"; trap focus inside; focus return should go back to the primary CTA in the header. row action buttons need aria-labels like: aria-label="Open actions for vector v123".
Marta (Engineering): persisting export mapping per-user is straightforward — we can store the last mapping and expose "Apply recent mapping" in the modal.
Priya (PM): question: when selection spans pages, header CTA should show count and a dropdown: "Download (5) ▾" with options. if user clears selection, should the UI forget the mapping? i'd prefer to persist the mapping for convenience.
Lenora (Design): accessibility nit for relevance-pill: current color contrast ~2.3:1 at small sizes. propose using darker blue (#0b63d6) or white text on a darker chip; update figma.
Ken (Product): large export handling: if selected rows exceed 10k, show a brief warning banner: "Large export may take several minutes — we'll email you when it's ready." and offer server-side background export with email notification.
Amit (Frontend): also add aria-sort on header sort buttons and an aria-live announcement when sort changes. and for the tooltip, use a11y-friendly hover+focus behavior.
OpsBot: deploy:design-staging succeeded — updated with the figma tweaks. :rocket:
Lenora (Design): next steps: Amit to implement persistent selection + aria-live; Marta to add mapping persistence; Jasper to produce a short a11y PR checklist; Ken/Priya to finalize CTA copy. Please aim for PRs by Wednesday EOD.
